verses.sanskrit: अथ प्रथमोऽध्यायः॥ ॐ अथातो ब्रह्मजिज्ञासा ॐ
verses.transliteration: atha prathamo.adhyAyaH|| OM athAto brahmajij~nAsA OM
verses.translation: Now, therefore, the inquiry into Brahman.
verses.hindi: अब, इसलिए, ब्रह्म की जिज्ञासा (अन्वेषण) करें।
verses.wordMeaning: Four words that open the entire Vedanta tradition. "Atha" (now) — this inquiry cannot be postponed. "Ataḥ" (therefore) — because human life is finite and the highest question demands attention. "Brahma" — the ultimate reality, consciousness, the ground of all existence. "Jijñāsā" — not doctrine or belief but living inquiry, open investigation.
verses.explanation: Four words that open the entire Vedanta tradition. "Atha" (now) — this inquiry cannot be postponed. verses.translation: That from which the origin, sustenance, and dissolution of this (universe) proceed — that is Brahman.
verses.hindi: जिससे इस जगत की उत्पत्ति, स्थिति और प्रलय होती है — वह ब्रह्म है।
verses.wordMeaning: The Brahma Sutra's definition of Brahman is functional, not theological: Brahman is identified by what it does — creates, sustains, and dissolves all existence. This is not a claim about a deity; it is a philosophical pointer to the ground of existence itself. Whatever underlies and enables the entire process of the universe — that is what Vyasa means by Brahman.

verses.translation: Because the scriptures are the source (of valid knowledge of Brahman).
verses.hindi: क्योंकि शास्त्र (वेद-उपनिषद) ब्रह्मज्ञान का स्रोत हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Brahman cannot be known through ordinary perception or logical inference alone — the testimony of those who have directly realised it (the Upanishadic seers) is a necessary means of knowledge. This is not blind faith — it is epistemological precision. Just as you need specialised instruments to measure gamma rays, you need the "instrument" of authoritative testimony for knowledge that lies beyond ordinary cognitive reach.

verses.translation: But that (Brahman) — through harmonisation (of all scriptural teachings).
verses.hindi: परंतु वह (ब्रह्म) — समन्वय (समन्वित अनुशीलन) से जाना जाता है।
verses.commentary: One of the Brahma Sutra's most important methodological sutras: the path to Brahman is through the harmonious synthesis of all scriptural teachings — not selective quotation, not sectarian emphasis. 'Samanvaya' means 'bringing together into harmony.' The truth is found not in any one teaching but in the pattern that all authentic teachings share when viewed together.

verses.science: परंतु वह (ब्रह्म) — समन्वय (समन्वित अनुशीलन) से जाना जाता है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.translation: On account of seeing (consciousness), primordial matter is not the first cause (as it has no self-awareness).
verses.hindi: देखने (दर्शन/ईक्षण) के कारण, प्रधान (जड़ प्रकृति) प्रथम कारण नहीं हो सकती।
verses.commentary: Vyasa's refutation of Samkhya philosophy's claim that inert Prakriti (primordial matter) is the first cause of the universe. The Brahma Sutra argues: the Upanishads say the first cause 'saw' (ikshata) before creating. Inert matter cannot see — only consciousness can. Therefore, consciousness, not matter, is the first cause. This is the foundational argument of idealist Vedanta.

verses.science: देखने (दर्शन/ईक्षण) के कारण, प्रधान (जड़ प्रकृति) प्रथम कारण नहीं हो सकती। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.translation: If "seeing" is said to be used in a figurative sense — no, because of the word "Self" (used of the cause).
verses.hindi: यदि कहें कि 'ईक्षण' गौण (लाक्षणिक) है, तो ऐसा नहीं; क्योंकि कारण के लिए 'आत्म' शब्द का प्रयोग हुआ है।

verses.translation: Because liberation is taught for one who is devoted to that (Being).
verses.hindi: क्योंकि उस आत्मतत्त्व में निष्ठा रखने वाले के लिए मोक्ष का उपदेश दिया गया है।

verses.translation: And because it is not stated that it (the Being) is to be rejected.
verses.hindi: और क्योंकि उस आत्मस्वरूप का त्याग करने का कोई कथन नहीं है।

verses.translation: Because of the merging into its own Self (of the individual, in deep sleep).
verses.hindi: क्योंकि सुषुप्ति में जीवात्मा का अपने स्वरूप (ब्रह्म) में लय हो जाता है।

verses.translation: Because of the uniformity of the scriptural statements (about the cause of the world).
verses.hindi: क्योंकि समस्त वेदान्त वाक्यों में चेतन कारण के विषय में एकरूपता है।

verses.translation: And because (its being a conscious cause) is stated in scripture.
verses.hindi: और क्योंकि श्रुति में स्पष्ट रूप से ऐसा कहा गया है।

verses.translation: The inner Self is bliss (anandamaya) — on account of repetition (in the Upanishads).
verses.hindi: आनन्दमय (आत्मा ही आनन्दमय है) — क्योंकि उपनिषदों में इसकी बार-बार पुष्टि है।
verses.commentary: The Brahma Sutra establishes, through the repetition method (abhyasa), that the innermost Self (Anandamaya) is not merely a sheath of bliss but is identical with Brahman itself. The deepest layer of the person is not suffering, not limitation, not a separate ego — it is pure ananda (bliss). This is a constitutional claim about the nature of consciousness: its ground state is bliss, not pain.
verses.wordMeaning: The Brahma Sutra establishes, through the repetition method (abhyasa), that the innermost Self (Anandamaya) is not merely a sheath of bliss but is identical with Brahman itself. The deepest layer of the person is not suffering, not limitation, not a separate ego — it is pure ananda (bliss). This is a constitutional claim about the nature of consciousness: its ground state is bliss, not pain.
verses.science: आनन्दमय (आत्मा ही आनन्दमय है) — क्योंकि उपनिषदों में इसकी बार-बार पुष्टि है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.translation: If it be said that the Blissful is not the Supreme because the word denotes a modification (-maya) — no, because the suffix denotes abundance.
verses.hindi: यदि कहें कि 'मयट्' प्रत्यय विकार का वाचक है, तो ऐसा नहीं; क्योंकि यहाँ यह प्रचुरता के अर्थ में है।

verses.translation: And because it is declared to be the cause of that (bliss).
verses.hindi: और क्योंकि वह परमात्मा ही सबको आनन्द देने का हेतु (कारण) कहा गया है।

verses.translation: And that same (Brahman) is sung of in the mantra portion of the Veda.
verses.hindi: और मन्त्रवर्ण में जिस सत्य-ज्ञान-अनन्त ब्रह्म का गान किया गया है, वही आनन्दमय है।

verses.translation: Not the other (the individual soul), because that is not possible.
verses.hindi: जीवात्मा आनन्दमय नहीं है, क्योंकि अनुपपत्ति (असंगति) होती है।

verses.translation: And because of the declaration of difference (between the two).
verses.hindi: और जीवात्मा तथा आनन्दमय परमात्मा में भेद का कथन होने से भी जीव आनन्दमय नहीं है।

verses.translation: And because of (the mention of) desire, there is no need to look for an inferred (Pradhana as cause).
verses.hindi: और काम (इच्छा) के उल्लेख से भी प्रधान (प्रकृति) आनन्दमय नहीं हो सकती।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ अस्मिन्नस्य च तद्योगं शास्ति ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM asminnasya cha tadyogaM shAsti OM
verses.translation: And scripture teaches the union of this (individual soul) with that (Blissful One) in it.
verses.hindi: और इस आनन्दमय से ही जीवात्मा के योग (ऐक्य) का उपदेश दिया गया है।

verses.translation: The one within (the sun and the eye) is the Lord, because of the teaching of his attributes.
verses.hindi: सूर्य और नेत्र के भीतर रहने वाला पुरुष परमात्मा ही है, क्योंकि उसी के धर्मों का उपदेश है।

verses.translation: And he is another than the individual soul, because of the declaration of difference.
verses.hindi: और भेद का कथन होने के कारण वह जीवात्मा से अन्य (परमात्मा) है।

verses.translation: Space (akasha) is Brahman, because of its characteristic marks.
verses.hindi: आकाश शब्द से यहाँ परब्रह्म ही ग्राह्य है, क्योंकि उसी के लक्षण कहे गये हैं।

verses.translation: For that very reason, prana (the vital principle in the text) is also Brahman.
verses.hindi: इसी कारण से प्राण शब्द से भी परब्रह्म ही समझा जाता है।

verses.translation: The light (in the text) is Brahman, because of the mention of "feet" in the context.
verses.hindi: चरणों (पादों) का उल्लेख होने के कारण ज्योति शब्द से परब्रह्म का ही बोध होता है।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ छन्दोऽभिधानान्नेतिचेन्न तथाचेतोऽर्पणनिगदात्तथा हि दर्शनम् ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM Chando.abhidhAnAnnetichenna tathAcheto.arpaNanigadAttathA hi darshanam OM
verses.translation: If it be said that it is not Brahman because a metre (Gayatri) is mentioned — no, since the directing of the mind on Brahman through the metre is thus taught; and so it is seen elsewhere.
verses.hindi: If it be said that it is not परब्रह्म because a metre (Gayatri) is mentioned — no, since the directing of the मन on परब्रह्म through the metre is thus taught; and so it देखा जाता है elsewhere.।

verses.translation: And thus the statement of the (four) feet as beings and so on is also justified.
verses.hindi: And thus श्रुति का वचन of the (four) feet as beings and so on is also justified.।

verses.translation: If it be said that it is not so because of a difference in the teaching — no, because in both statements there is no contradiction.
verses.hindi: यदि कहें कि it is ऐसा नहीं है because of a भेद in the teaching, तो ऐसा नहीं; क्योंकि in both statements कोई विरोध नहीं है.।

verses.translation: Prana is Brahman, because of the connection (of the context) thus.
verses.hindi: Prana is परब्रह्म, because of संबंध (of the प्रकरण (प्रसंग)) thus.।

verses.translation: If it be said that it is not Brahman because the speaker (Indra) teaches about himself — (we reply) no, for there is abundant reference to the Self in this chapter.
verses.hindi: If it be said that it is not परब्रह्म because the speaker (Indra) teaches about himself — (we reply) no, for there is abundant reference to परमात्मा (आत्मतत्त्व) in this chapter.।

verses.translation: The teaching (by Indra) is given through insight from scripture, as in the case of Vamadeva.
verses.hindi: The teaching (by Indra) is given through insight from श्रुति (वेद), as in the case of Vamadeva.।

verses.translation: If it be said that it is not Brahman because of marks of the individual soul and the chief breath — no, because of the threefold nature of the meditation (on the soul, on the breath, on Brahman), and because those marks are here taken up on that basis.
verses.hindi: यदि कहें कि it is not परब्रह्म because of marks of जीवात्मा and the chief breath, तो ऐसा नहीं; क्योंकि of the threefold nature of the उपासना/ध्यान (on जीवात्मा, on the breath, on परब्रह्म), and because those marks are here taken up on that basis.।

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीमत्कृष्णद्वैपायनकृतब्रह्मसूत्रेषु प्रथमाध्यायस्य प्रथमः पादः समाप्तः ॐ सर्वत्र प्रसिद्धोपदेशात् ॐ
verses.transliteration: iti shrImatkR^iShNadvaipAyanakR^itabrahmasUtreShu prathamAdhyAyasya prathamaH pAdaH samAptaH OM sarvatra prasiddhopadeshAt OM
verses.translation: (The one made of mind is Brahman,) because of the teaching of what is well known everywhere (in the Upanishads as the object of meditation).
verses.hindi: सब जगह प्रसिद्ध परमेश्वर के गुणों का ही उपदेश होने से वह ब्रह्म है।

verses.translation: And because the qualities intended to be taught are appropriate (to Brahman).
verses.hindi: और विवक्षित (वर्णन करने योग्य) गुणों की उपपत्ति बैठने के कारण भी वही ब्रह्म है।

verses.translation: But not the embodied soul, because those qualities are not possible for it.
verses.hindi: जीवात्मा में ये गुण घटित न होने से वह शारीर (जीव) नहीं हो सकता।

verses.translation: And because of the declaration of object and agent (the one to be attained and the attainer).
verses.hindi: कर्म और कर्ता का अलग-अलग कथन होने से भी जीवात्मा से ब्रह्म भिन्न है।

verses.translation: Because of the difference of case-endings (in the text).
verses.hindi: शब्द के विशेष प्रयोग से भी यह सिद्ध होता है।

verses.translation: And because of the Smriti.
verses.hindi: और स्मृति (भगवद्गीता आदि) के वचनों से भी यही सिद्ध होता है।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ अर्भकौकस्त्वात् तद्व्यपदेशाच्च नेति चेन्न निचाय्यत्वादेवं व्योमवच्च ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM arbhakaukastvAt tadvyapadeshAchcha neti chenna nichAyyatvAdevaM vyomavachcha OM
verses.translation: If it be said that it is not Brahman because of the smallness of its abode and because it is so declared — no, because (it is so) for the sake of meditation, and (it is great) like space.
verses.hindi: यदि कहें कि it is not परब्रह्म because of the smallness of its abode and because it is so declared, तो ऐसा नहीं; क्योंकि (it is so) for the sake of उपासना/ध्यान, and (it is great) like space.।

verses.translation: If it be said that (Brahman) would then have experience of enjoyment — no, because of the difference (between the natures of the two).
verses.hindi: यदि कहें कि (परब्रह्म) would then have experience of enjoyment, तो ऐसा नहीं; क्योंकि of the भेद (between the natures of the two).।

verses.translation: The eater is Brahman, because of the mention of the moving and the unmoving (as his food).
verses.hindi: चराचर जगत का भक्षक (प्रलयकर्ता) होने के कारण अत्ता परमात्मा ही है।

verses.translation: And because of the context.
verses.hindi: और प्रकरण (प्रसंग) भी उसी परब्रह्म का है।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ गुहां प्रविष्टावात्मानौ हि तद्दर्शनात् ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM guhAM praviShTAvAtmAnau hi taddarshanAt OM
verses.translation: The two that have entered the cave are the two selves (the individual and the Supreme), because it is seen thus.
verses.hindi: गुहा में प्रविष्ट दोनों (जीवात्मा और परमात्मा) ही हैं, क्योंकि ऐसा श्रुति-दर्शन है।

verses.translation: And because of the qualifying terms.
verses.hindi: और दोनों के विशेषणों से भी यही सिद्ध होता है।

verses.translation: The one within (the eye) is Brahman, because that is appropriate.
verses.hindi: The one within (the eye) is परब्रह्म, because that is appropriate.।

verses.translation: And because of the mention of place and the like.
verses.hindi: और the mention of place and the like. होने के कारण।

verses.translation: And because of the mention of one characterised by bliss.
verses.hindi: और the mention of one characterised by bliss. होने के कारण।

verses.translation: And because of the mention of the path of one who has learned the secret teaching.
verses.hindi: और the mention of the path of one who has learned the secret teaching. होने के कारण।

verses.translation: The other (the reflection, or the soul) is not meant, because of its lack of permanence and the impossibility (of those qualities).
verses.hindi: The other (the reflection, or जीवात्मा) is not meant, because of its lack of permanence and the impossibility (of those qualities).।

verses.translation: The inner controller in the (texts concerning) the gods and so on is Brahman, because of the declaration of his attributes.
verses.hindi: The inner controller in the (texts concerning) the gods and so on is परब्रह्म, because of the declaration of his attributes.।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ न च स्मार्तं अतद्धर्माभिपालात् ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM na cha smArtaM ataddharmAbhipAlAt OM
verses.translation: And it is not the (Pradhana) of the Smriti, because attributes not belonging to it are stated.
verses.hindi: And it is not the (Pradhana) of स्मृति (गीता आदि), because attributes not belonging to it are stated.।

verses.translation: And the embodied soul is not (the inner controller); for both (recensions) speak of him as different.
verses.hindi: And the embodied soul is not (the inner controller); for both (recensions) speak of him as different.।

verses.translation: The one with the qualities of invisibility and so on is Brahman, because of the statement of his attributes.
verses.hindi: The one with the qualities of invisibility and so on is परब्रह्म, because of श्रुति का वचन of his attributes.।

verses.translation: The other two (the soul and Pradhana) are not meant, because of the qualifications and the declaration of difference.
verses.hindi: The other two (जीवात्मा and Pradhana) are not meant, because of the qualifications and the declaration of भेद.।

verses.translation: And because of the mention of (his) form.
verses.hindi: और the mention of (his) form. होने के कारण।

verses.translation: Vaishvanara is Brahman, because of the specific qualifications of the common term.
verses.hindi: Vaishvanara is परब्रह्म, because of the specific qualifications of the common term.।

verses.translation: What is remembered in Smriti would be an indication (of what the Vedic text says).
verses.hindi: What is remembered in स्मृति would be an लिंग (संकेत) (of what the Vedic text says).।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ शब्दादिभ्योऽन्तः प्रतिष्ठानान्नेति चेन्न तथा दृष्ट्युपदेशादसंभवात्पुरुषविध्मपि चैनमधीयते ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM shabdAdibhyo.antaH pratiShThAnAnneti chenna tathA dR^iShTyupadeshAdasaMbhavAtpuruShavidhmapi chainamadhIyate OM
verses.translation: If it be said that it is not Brahman because of the words (agni and so on) and because it is described as established within — no, because it is taught as an object of meditation, because (otherwise) it would be impossible, and because they also teach him as having the form of a person.
verses.hindi: यदि कहें कि it is not परब्रह्म because of the words (agni and so on) and because it is described as established within, तो ऐसा नहीं; क्योंकि it उपदेश दिया गया है as an object of उपासना/ध्यान, because (otherwise) it would be impossible, and because they also teach him as having the form of a person.।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ अत एव न देवता भूतं च ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM ata eva na devatA bhUtaM cha OM
verses.translation: For this very reason Vaishvanara is neither a deity nor an element.
verses.hindi: For this very reason Vaishvanara is neither a deity nor an element.।

verses.translation: Jaimini says that meditation directly on Brahman as Vaishvanara also involves no contradiction.
verses.hindi: Jaimini कहते हैं कि उपासना/ध्यान directly on परब्रह्म as Vaishvanara also involves no contradiction.।

verses.translation: Ashmarathya holds that it is because of manifestation (in the worshipper).
verses.hindi: Ashmarathya का मत है कि it is because of manifestation (in the worshipper).।

verses.translation: Badari holds that it is because of remembrance (in meditation).
verses.hindi: Badari का मत है कि it is because of remembrance (in उपासना/ध्यान).।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ सम्पत्तेरिति जैमिनिः तथा हि दर्शयति ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM sampatteriti jaiminiH tathA hi darshayati OM
verses.translation: Jaimini holds that it is because of (symbolic) identification; for thus (scripture) shows.
verses.hindi: Jaimini का मत है कि it is because of (symbolic) identification; for thus (श्रुति (वेद)) shows.।

verses.translation: And they teach him as (located) in this (body).
verses.hindi: And they teach him as (located) in this (body).।

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीमत्कृष्णद्वैपायनकृतब्रह्मसूत्रेषु प्रथमाध्यायस्य द्वितीयः पादः समाप्तः ॐ द्युभ्वाद्यायतनं स्वशब्दात् ॐ
verses.transliteration: iti shrImatkR^iShNadvaipAyanakR^itabrahmasUtreShu prathamAdhyAyasya dvitIyaH pAdaH samAptaH OM dyubhvAdyAyatanaM svashabdAt OM
verses.translation: The abode of heaven, earth and so on is Brahman, because of the word "own" (the Self).
verses.hindi: द्युलोक और पृथ्वी आदि का आधार परब्रह्म ही है, क्योंकि 'स्व' (आत्म) शब्द का प्रयोग है।

verses.translation: Because it is declared to be the goal to be reached by the liberated.
verses.hindi: मुक्त पुरुषों के प्राप्य होने के निर्देश से भी वह ब्रह्म ही है।

verses.translation: Not the inferred (Pradhana), because there is no word denoting it.
verses.hindi: अनुमान-गम्य (प्रधान) इसका आधार नहीं है, क्योंकि अतद्वाचक शब्द हैं।

verses.translation: Nor the individual soul.
verses.hindi: और प्राणभृत् (जीवात्मा) भी इसका आधार नहीं है।

verses.translation: Because of the declaration of difference.
verses.hindi: भेद के कथन से भी जीवात्मा आधार नहीं है।

verses.translation: Because of the context.
verses.hindi: और प्रकरण के कारण भी आधार परब्रह्म ही है।

verses.translation: And because of the mention of abiding and eating (one looking on, the other eating).
verses.hindi: स्थिति और अदन (उपभोग) के भेद-दर्शन से भी ब्रह्म ही सिद्ध होता है।

verses.translation: The Infinite (Bhuma) is Brahman, because of the teaching (of it) beyond the state of deep sleep.
verses.hindi: भूमा परब्रह्म ही है, क्योंकि संप्रसाद (सुषुप्ति/जीव) से परे उपदेश है।

verses.translation: And because its attributes are appropriate (to Brahman).
verses.hindi: और धर्मोपपत्ति (अमृतत्व आदि गुणों की संगति) होने से भूमा ब्रह्म ही है।

verses.translation: The Imperishable is Brahman, because it upholds everything up to space.
verses.hindi: अक्षर परब्रह्म ही है, क्योंकि यह अम्बर (आकाश) पर्यन्त सबका धारक है।

verses.translation: And that upholding is by (Brahman), because of the ruling (mentioned).
verses.hindi: और यह धारण कार्य शासन (प्रशासन) के द्वारा होने से सिद्ध होता है।

verses.translation: And because it excludes other natures.
verses.hindi: अन्य (प्रधान या जीव) का व्यवच्छेद (निषेध) होने से भी अक्षर ब्रह्म ही है।

verses.translation: He (the Supreme) is the object of seeing, according to the declaration of the text.
verses.hindi: He (परमेश्वर) is the object of seeing, according to the declaration of the text.।

verses.translation: The small (space in the heart) is Brahman, because of the subsequent statements.
verses.hindi: दहराकाश परब्रह्म ही है, क्योंकि उसके उत्तरवर्ती वाक्यों से यह सिद्ध होता है।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ गतिशब्दाभ्यां तथा हि दृष्टं लिङ्गं च ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM gatishabdAbhyAM tathA hi dR^iShTaM li~NgaM cha OM
verses.translation: Because of the "going" and the word (Brahman-world); for thus it is seen, and there is also an indication.
verses.hindi: the "going" and the word (परब्रह्म-world); for thus it देखा जाता है, and there is also an लिंग (संकेत). होने के कारण।

verses.translation: And because of the supporting (of the worlds) and because its greatness is perceived in it.
verses.hindi: और the supporting (of the worlds) and because its greatness is perceived in it. होने के कारण।

verses.translation: And because of well-known usage.
verses.hindi: और well-known usage. होने के कारण।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ इतरपरामर्शात् स इति चेन्नासम्भवात् ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM itaraparAmarshAt sa iti chennAsambhavAt OM
verses.translation: If it be said that it is the individual soul because of the reference to the other, no, because that is impossible.
verses.hindi: If it be said that it is जीवात्मा because of the reference to the other, no, because that is impossible.।

verses.translation: If it be said that (the individual is meant) because of the later text — (we say) it refers to the soul with its true nature manifested.
verses.hindi: If it be said that (the individual is meant) because of the later text — (we say) it refers to जीवात्मा with its true nature manifested.।

verses.translation: And the reference (to the soul) serves another purpose.
verses.hindi: And the reference (to जीवात्मा) serves another purpose.।

verses.translation: If it be said that (it cannot be Brahman) because of the mention of smallness, that has been answered.
verses.hindi: If it be said that (it cannot be परब्रह्म) because of the mention of smallness, that has been answered.।

verses.translation: (The luminous one) follows (Brahman), and this whole (world) shines by its light.
verses.hindi: (The luminous one) follows (परब्रह्म), and this whole (world) shines by its light.।

verses.translation: This too is stated in the Smriti.
verses.hindi: This too is stated in स्मृति (गीता आदि).।

verses.sanskrit: पाठभेद अपि च स्मर्यते ॐ शब्दादेव प्रमितः ॐ
verses.transliteration: pAThabheda api cha smaryate OM shabdAdeva pramitaH OM
verses.translation: The one of the measure of a thumb is Brahman, because of the word itself.
verses.hindi: The one of the measure of a thumb is परब्रह्म, because of the word itself.।

verses.translation: It is with reference to the heart, and because human beings alone are eligible (for such knowledge).
verses.hindi: It is with reference to the heart, and because human beings alone are eligible (for such तत्त्वज्ञान).।

verses.translation: Badarayana holds that (beings) above them (the gods) are also eligible, because it is possible.
verses.hindi: Badarayana का मत है कि (beings) above them (the gods) are also eligible, because it is possible.।

verses.translation: If it be said that (the bodies of the gods) contradict sacrificial action — no, because of the assuming of many forms, as is seen.
verses.hindi: यदि कहें कि (the bodies of the gods) contradict sacrificial action, तो ऐसा नहीं; क्योंकि of the assuming of many forms, as देखा जाता है.।

verses.translation: If it be said that (there is a contradiction) with the Vedic word — no, because from it (the world) originates, as shown by direct revelation and Smriti.
verses.hindi: यदि कहें कि (there is a contradiction) with the Vedic word, तो ऐसा नहीं; क्योंकि from it (the world) originates, as shown by direct revelation and स्मृति.।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ अत एव च नित्यत्वम् ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM ata eva cha nityatvam OM
verses.translation: For this very reason, the eternity (of the Veda) also.
verses.hindi: For this very reason, the eternity (of the Veda) also.।

verses.translation: Because of the sameness of names and forms, there is no contradiction even in the recurrence (of creation), as shown by Sruti and Smriti.
verses.hindi: the sameness of names and forms, कोई विरोध नहीं है even in the recurrence (of सृष्टि), as shown by श्रुति and स्मृति. होने के कारण।

verses.translation: Jaimini holds that the gods are not eligible (for Brahma-knowledge), because it is impossible in the case of meditations such as the Madhu-vidya.
verses.hindi: Jaimini का मत है कि the gods are not eligible (for Brahma-तत्त्वज्ञान), because it is impossible in the case of meditations such as the Madhu-vidya.।

verses.translation: And because (the gods) are found in the sphere of light.
verses.hindi: और क्योंकि (the gods) are found in the sphere of light.।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ भावं तु बादरायणोऽस्ति हि ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM bhAvaM tu bAdarAyaNo.asti hi OM
verses.translation: But Badarayana holds that (eligibility) exists, for (it is possible).
verses.hindi: But Badarayana का मत है कि (eligibility) exists, for (it is possible).।

verses.translation: The word "shuc" (grief) in Janashruti's case is hinted at by his hearing the contemptuous remark and by his running to (Raikva).
verses.hindi: The word "shuc" (grief) in Janashruti's case is hinted at by his hearing the contemptuous remark and by his running to (Raikva).।

verses.translation: And since he is known to be a Kshatriya, from the mention of Chaitraratha later on.
verses.hindi: And since he is known to be a Kshatriya, from the mention of Chaitraratha later on.।

verses.translation: Because of the mention of purificatory rites, and because their absence is stated (in the case of Satyakama).
verses.hindi: the mention of purificatory rites, and because their absence is stated (in the case of Satyakama). होने के कारण।

verses.translation: And because he was taken up (for teaching) upon ascertaining the absence of that (Shudra-hood).
verses.hindi: और क्योंकि he was taken up (for teaching) upon ascertaining अभाव that (Shudra-hood).।

verses.translation: Because hearing, studying and understanding the meaning are forbidden (to Shudras), and because of the Smriti.
verses.hindi: क्योंकि hearing, studying and understanding the meaning are forbidden (to Shudras), and because of स्मृति (गीता आदि).।

verses.translation: (The all-moving life is Brahman,) because of the trembling (of the whole world).
verses.hindi: (The all-moving life is परब्रह्म,) because of the trembling (of the whole world).।

verses.translation: The light (is Brahman), because it is seen (in the text).
verses.hindi: The light (is परब्रह्म), because it देखा जाता है (in the text).।

verses.translation: Space (in the text) is Brahman, because of the declaration that it is different in nature and so on.
verses.hindi: Space (in the text) is परब्रह्म, because of the declaration that it is different in nature and so on.।

verses.translation: Because of the difference (of the Self from the soul) in deep sleep and in departure.
verses.hindi: the भेद (of परमात्मा (आत्मतत्त्व) from जीवात्मा) in सुषुप्ति and in departure. होने के कारण।

verses.translation: Because of words such as "lord."
verses.hindi: words such as "lord." होने के कारण।

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीमत्कृष्णद्वैपायनकृतब्रह्मसूत्रेषु प्रथमाध्यायस्य तृतीयः पादः समाप्तः ॐ आनुमानिकमप्येकेषामिति चेन्न शरीररूपकविन्यस्तगृहीतेर्दर्शयति च ॐ
verses.transliteration: iti shrImatkR^iShNadvaipAyanakR^itabrahmasUtreShu prathamAdhyAyasya tR^itIyaH pAdaH samAptaH OM AnumAnikamapyekeShAmiti chenna sharIrarUpakavinyastagR^ihIterdarshayati cha OM
verses.translation: If it be said that even the inferred (Pradhana) is found in some recensions — no, because what is mentioned is the body, imagined as a chariot; and the text shows this.
verses.hindi: यदि कहें कि even the inferred (Pradhana) is found in some recensions, तो ऐसा नहीं; क्योंकि what is mentioned is the body, imagined as a chariot; and the text shows this.।

verses.translation: But the subtle (is the causal body), because it is fit to be so called.
verses.hindi: But the subtle (is the causal body), because it is fit to be so called.।

verses.translation: (Its existence is admitted) because it depends on the Lord; it serves a purpose.
verses.hindi: (Its existence is admitted) because it depends on ईश्वर; it serves a purpose.।

verses.translation: And because it is not said to be an object of knowledge.
verses.hindi: और क्योंकि it is not said to be an object of तत्त्वज्ञान.।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ वदतीति चेन्न प्राज्ञो हि ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM vadatIti chenna prAj~no hi OM
verses.translation: If it be said that (the text) declares it (as an object of knowledge) — no, for (the text speaks of) the Supreme Self.
verses.hindi: If it be said that (the text) declares it (as an object of तत्त्वज्ञान) — no, for (the text speaks of) परमेश्वर Self.।

verses.sanskrit: पाठभेद 1.4.5 and 6 combined ॐ प्रकरणात् ॐ
verses.transliteration: pAThabheda ## 1.4.5 and 6 combined ## OM prakaraNAt OM
verses.translation: Because of the context (the object of knowledge is the Supreme Self).
verses.hindi: the प्रकरण (प्रसंग) (the object of तत्त्वज्ञान is परमेश्वर Self). होने के कारण।

verses.translation: Of three things only is there such a statement and question (not of the Pradhana).
verses.hindi: Of three things only is there such a statement and question (not of the Pradhana).।

verses.translation: And (as in the case of) the "great."
verses.hindi: And (as in the case of) the "great."।

verses.translation: (The "unborn" is not the Sankhya Pradhana,) because there is no specification, as in the case of the (Vedic) cup.
verses.hindi: (The "unborn" is not the Sankhya Pradhana,) because there is no specification, as in the case of the (Vedic) cup.।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ ज्योतिरुपक्रमा तु तथा ह्यधीयत एके ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM jyotirupakramA tu tathA hyadhIyata eke OM
verses.translation: But (the "unborn") begins with light (Brahman), for so some read.
verses.hindi: But (the "unborn") begins with light (परब्रह्म), for so some read.।

verses.translation: And because imagining is taught, there is no contradiction, as in the case of the honey (of the sun) and the like.
verses.hindi: और क्योंकि imagining उपदेश दिया गया है, कोई विरोध नहीं है, as in the case of the honey (of the sun) and the like.।

verses.translation: Nor (does it refer to the Sankhya categories) from the mention of a number, because of the diversity and because of the excess.
verses.hindi: Nor (does it refer to the Sankhya categories) from the mention of a number, because of the diversity and because of the excess.।

verses.translation: Prana and the rest (are Brahman's attributes), because of the remainder of the sentence.
verses.hindi: Prana and the rest (are परब्रह्म's attributes), because of the remainder of the sentence.।

verses.translation: In some recensions, where food is not mentioned, (the five are counted) by means of light.
verses.hindi: In some recensions, where food is not mentioned, (the five are counted) by means of light.।

verses.translation: And Brahman is taught as the cause in the texts about space and the rest, as stated.
verses.hindi: And परब्रह्म उपदेश दिया गया है as the cause in the texts about space and the rest, as stated.।

verses.translation: Because of the drawing together (of the earlier and later texts).
verses.hindi: the drawing together (of the earlier and later texts). होने के कारण।

verses.translation: Because "work" denotes the world.
verses.hindi: क्योंकि "work" denotes the world.।

verses.translation: If it be said that it is not Brahman because of marks of the individual soul and the chief breath, that has been explained.
verses.hindi: If it be said that it is not परब्रह्म because of marks of जीवात्मा and the chief breath, that has been explained.।

verses.sanskrit: (जीवमुख्यप्राणलिङ्गादिति) ॐ अन्यार्थं तु जैमिनिः प्रश्नव्याख्यानाभ्यामपि चैवमेके ॐ
verses.transliteration: (jIvamukhyaprANali~NgAditi) OM anyArthaM tu jaiminiH prashnavyAkhyAnAbhyAmapi chaivameke OM
verses.translation: Jaimini holds that the reference (to the soul) is for another purpose, because of the question and the answer; and so some also read.
verses.hindi: Jaimini का मत है कि the reference (to जीवात्मा) is for another purpose, because of the question and the answer; and so some also read.।

verses.translation: Because of the connection of the sentences.
verses.hindi: संबंध of the sentences. होने के कारण।

verses.translation: Ashmarathya thinks the mention (of the soul) is a mark (of the identity of soul and Brahman), for the proof of the proposition.
verses.hindi: Ashmarathya thinks the mention (of जीवात्मा) is a mark (of the identity of soul and परब्रह्म), for the proof of the proposition.।

verses.translation: Audulomi says it is because of such a state on the soul's departure (from the body).
verses.hindi: Audulomi says it is because of such a state on जीवात्मा's departure (from the body).।

verses.translation: Kashakritsna says it is because (Brahman) abides (as the soul).
verses.hindi: Kashakritsna says it is because (परब्रह्म) abides (as जीवात्मा).।

verses.translation: Brahman is also the material cause, because this does not contradict the proposition and the illustration.
verses.hindi: परब्रह्म is also the उपादान कारण, because this does not contradict the proposition and the illustration.।

verses.translation: And because of the teaching of reflection (in creation).
verses.hindi: और the teaching of reflection (in सृष्टि). होने के कारण।

verses.translation: And because both (origin and dissolution) are directly stated (as from Brahman).
verses.hindi: और क्योंकि both (origin and प्रलय) are directly stated (as from परब्रह्म).।

verses.translation: Because it made itself, through transformation.
verses.hindi: क्योंकि it made itself, through transformation.।

verses.translation: And because (Brahman) is described as the source (womb).
verses.hindi: और क्योंकि (परब्रह्म) is described as the source (womb).।

verses.translation: By this all (other views) are explained; explained.
verses.hindi: इसी से all (other views) are explained; explained.।

verses.sanskrit: अथ द्वितीयोऽध्यायः॥ ॐ स्मृत्यनवकाशदोषप्रसङ्ग इति चेन्नान्यस्मृत्यनवकाशदोषप्रसङ्गात् ॐ
verses.transliteration: atha dvitIyo.adhyAyaH|| OM smR^ityanavakAshadoShaprasa~Nga iti chennAnyasmR^ityanavakAshadoShaprasa~NgAt OM
verses.translation: If it be said that (this view) leaves no room for certain Smritis (Kapila's), we reply: no, because (rejecting the other view) would leave no room for other Smritis (Manu's and the like).
verses.hindi: यदि कहें कि इससे सांख्य-स्मृति के लिए अवकाश नहीं रहेगा, तो ऐसा नहीं; क्योंकि ऐसा न मानने पर मनु आदि अन्य स्मृतियों के लिए अवकाश नहीं रहेगा।

verses.translation: And because the other (Sankhya) principles are not found in the Veda.
verses.hindi: और क्योंकि सांख्य के अन्य तत्त्व (महत्तत्त्व आदि) वेदों में नहीं पाए जाते हैं।

verses.translation: By this the Yoga system is also refuted.
verses.hindi: इसी युक्ति से योग-स्मृति का भी निराकरण हो जाता है।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ न विलक्षणत्वादस्य तथात्वं च शब्दात् ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM na vilakShaNatvAdasya tathAtvaM cha shabdAt OM
verses.translation: (Objection:) Brahman cannot be the cause of this world, because of its being of a different nature; and so the word (of scripture) says.
verses.hindi: यदि कहें कि जगत का स्वभाव ब्रह्म से भिन्न होने से ब्रह्म इसका उपादान कारण नहीं हो सकता, और श्रुति भी ऐसा ही कहती है।

verses.translation: But (such cases of the unlike arising from the unlike) are seen.
verses.hindi: किंतु चेतन के समान कथन अभिमानी देवताओं के विषय में है, क्योंकि विशेष उल्लेख और संबंध देखा जाता है।

verses.translation: But the mention (of earth, water and so on as speaking) refers to their presiding deities, because of the specific mention and because of (the deities') entering.
verses.hindi: किंतु लोक में विलक्षण से विलक्षण की उत्पत्ति प्रत्यक्ष देखी जाती है।

verses.translation: And it is seen (that the conscious gives rise to the unconscious, as hair and nails from a man).
verses.hindi: प्रलय में कार्य के कारण में लय होने पर कारण में दोष की आपत्ति नहीं होती, क्योंकि ऐसा कोई दृष्टान्त नहीं है।

verses.sanskrit: पाठभेद दृश्यते तु ॐ असदिति चेन्न प्रतिषेधमात्रत्वात् ॐ
verses.transliteration: pAThabheda dR^ishyate tu OM asaditi chenna pratiShedhamAtratvAt OM
verses.translation: If it be said that (the effect) would then be non-existent (before its origin) — no, because that is merely a denial, with no counter-entity.
verses.hindi: और दोनों अवस्थाओं में कार्य के स्वरूप का बाध नहीं होता।

verses.translation: At dissolution, (the world would impart its qualities to Brahman,) so (your view) is inconsistent.
verses.hindi: अपीति (प्रलय) में भी दोष नहीं आता, क्योंकि दृष्टान्त उपस्थित हैं।

verses.translation: But not so, because there are examples (of cause and effect differing in nature without such consequence).
verses.hindi: स्वपक्ष (सांख्य) में भी यही दोष समान रूप से उपस्थित होता है।

verses.translation: And because the same fault applies to your own view.
verses.hindi: तर्क अप्रतिष्ठित (अनिश्चित) होने के कारण केवल तर्क से तत्त्व-निर्णय नहीं हो सकता।

verses.translation: Reasoning has no fixed footing; one may infer otherwise — but even then there would be the fault of no release.
verses.hindi: Reasoning has no fixed footing; one may infer otherwise — but even then there would be the fault of no release.।

verses.translation: By this, the views not accepted by the wise (such as atomism) are also explained (and refuted).
verses.hindi: By this, the views not accepted by the wise (such as atomism) are also explained (and निराकृत).।

verses.translation: If it be said that (the enjoyer's being merged in the cause) would lead to non-distinction (of enjoyer and enjoyed), we say: it may be so, as in the world (like the sea and its waves).
verses.hindi: कारण और कार्य का अनन्यत्व (अभेद) है, जैसा कि 'वाचारम्भण' श्रुति आदि से सिद्ध होता है।

verses.translation: The non-difference of that (effect) from it (the cause) (is known) from the word "origin" (arambhana) and other texts.
verses.hindi: The अभेद (अनन्यत्व) of that (effect) from it (the cause) (is known) from the word "origin" (arambhana) and other texts.।

verses.translation: And because (the effect) is perceived when the cause exists.
verses.hindi: और क्योंकि (the effect) is perceived when the cause exists.।

verses.translation: And because the later (effect) exists (in the cause).
verses.hindi: और क्योंकि the later (effect) exists (in the cause).।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ असद्व्यपदेशान्नेति चेन्न धर्मान्तरेण वाक्यशेषात् ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM asadvyapadeshAnneti chenna dharmAntareNa vAkyasheShAt OM
verses.translation: If it be said that (the effect is) not (in the cause) because of the declaration of non-existence — no, because that is by way of a different attribute, as the rest of the passage shows.
verses.hindi: यदि कहें कि (the effect is) not (in the cause) because of the declaration of non-existence, तो ऐसा नहीं; क्योंकि that is by way of a different attribute, as the rest of the passage shows.।

verses.translation: Because of reasoning and because of another text.
verses.hindi: reasoning and because of another text. होने के कारण।

verses.translation: And like a piece of cloth.
verses.hindi: And like a piece of cloth.।

verses.translation: And like the breath and the other functions.
verses.hindi: And like the breath and the other functions.।

verses.translation: Because of the declaration of the other (the soul as identical with Brahman), (Brahman would be liable to) faults such as not doing good to himself.
verses.hindi: the declaration of the other (जीवात्मा as identical with परब्रह्म), (परब्रह्म would be liable to) faults such as not doing good to himself. होने के कारण।

verses.translation: But (Brahman is) something more, because of the statement of difference.
verses.hindi: But (परब्रह्म is) something more, because of श्रुति का वचन of भेद.।

verses.translation: And that (objection) does not stand, as with stones and the like.
verses.hindi: And that (objection) does not stand, as with stones and the like.।

verses.translation: If it be said that (Brahman is not the cause) because we see the collection of materials — no, because it is like milk.
verses.hindi: यदि कहें कि (परब्रह्म is not the cause) because we see the collection of materials, तो ऐसा नहीं; क्योंकि it is like milk.।

verses.translation: As with gods and the like, also in the world.
verses.hindi: As with gods and the like, also in the world.।

verses.translation: (If Brahman were transformed,) either the whole would be involved, or the texts declaring it to be without parts would be violated.
verses.hindi: (If परब्रह्म were transformed,) either the whole would be involved, or the texts declaring it to be without parts would be violated.।

verses.translation: But not so, because scripture (says so), and Brahman is known from the word (scripture) alone.
verses.hindi: आत्मरूप ब्रह्म में विचित्र शक्तियों की उपपत्ति लोक-व्यवहार की भाँति सिद्ध है।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ आत्मनि चैवं विचित्राश्च हि ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM Atmani chaivaM vichitrAshcha hi OM
verses.translation: And in the Self also (such changes are possible), for there are many wonders of this kind.
verses.hindi: And in परमात्मा (आत्मतत्त्व) also (such changes are possible), for there are many wonders of this kind.।

verses.translation: And because of faults in your own view.
verses.hindi: और faults in your own view. होने के कारण।

verses.translation: And Brahman is endowed with all powers, because that is seen (in scripture).
verses.hindi: And परब्रह्म is endowed with all powers, because that देखा जाता है (in श्रुति (वेद)).।

verses.translation: If it be said that (Brahman) has no organs, that has been answered.
verses.hindi: If it be said that (परब्रह्म) has no इन्द्रियाँ, that has been answered.।

verses.translation: (Objection:) Brahman is not the creator, because he would then have a purpose.
verses.hindi: लोक में जैसे राजा की क्रीड़ा होती है, वैसे ही ब्रह्म की सृष्टि लीला-मात्र है।

verses.translation: But (creation is) mere sport, as in the world.
verses.hindi: सृष्टि में विषमता और नैर्घृण्य (क्रूरता) का दोष ब्रह्म पर नहीं आता, क्योंकि वह जीवों के कर्मों की अपेक्षा रखता है।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ वैष्यम्यनैर्घृण्ये न सापेक्षत्वात्तथा हि दर्शयति ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM vaiShyamyanairghR^iNye na sApekShatvAttathA hi darshayati OM
verses.translation: Partiality and cruelty do not attach to Brahman, because he acts in regard to (the beings' own karma); so scripture shows.
verses.hindi: यदि कहें कि सृष्टि के आरम्भ में कर्म नहीं थे, तो ऐसा नहीं; क्योंकि संसार अनादि है।

verses.translation: If it be said that (this is not possible) because of the non-distinction of works (before creation) — no, because (the world) is beginningless.
verses.hindi: और संसार की अनादित्वता उपपन्न होती है तथा शास्त्रों में भी ऐसा ही देखा जाता है।

verses.translation: (The beginninglessness) is reasonable and is also found (in scripture).
verses.hindi: और ब्रह्म में समस्त गुण उपपन्न होने से वह जगत का कारण सिद्ध होता है।

verses.translation: And because all attributes are appropriate (to Brahman as cause).
verses.hindi: और क्योंकि all attributes are appropriate (to परब्रह्म as cause).।

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीमत्कृष्णद्वैपायनकृतब्रह्मसूत्रेषु द्वितीयाध्यायस्य प्रथमः पादः समाप्तः ॐ रचनानुपपत्तेश्च नानुमानम् ॐ
verses.transliteration: iti shrImatkR^iShNadvaipAyanakR^itabrahmasUtreShu dvitIyAdhyAyasya prathamaH pAdaH samAptaH OM rachanAnupapatteshcha nAnumAnam OM
verses.translation: The inferred (Pradhana) is not the cause, because of the impossibility of the (world's) orderly arrangement.
verses.hindi: रचना की उपपत्ति न होने से अचेतन प्रधान (प्रकृति) जगत का कारण नहीं हो सकता।

verses.translation: And because of the (Pradhana's) activity.
verses.hindi: और प्रवृत्ति (क्रिया) का हेतु न होने से भी प्रधान कारण नहीं हो सकता।

verses.translation: If it be said that (it acts) like milk or water, (we reply) even there (a guiding agent is needed).
verses.hindi: जैसे दूध का दही बनना अचेतन से नहीं, वैसे ही यहाँ भी चेतन की अपेक्षा है।

verses.translation: And because (the Pradhana) has no fixed relation to (the qualities), being independent.
verses.hindi: और प्रधान के व्यापार का कोई अन्य प्रयोजक नहीं है।

verses.translation: And because (such a process) is not found elsewhere, it is not like grass and the like.
verses.hindi: और क्योंकि (such a process) is not found elsewhere, it is not like grass and the like.।

verses.translation: Even if (its activity) is admitted, there would be no purpose.
verses.hindi: Even if (its activity) is admitted, there would be no purpose.।

verses.translation: If it be said (it works) like the lame man and the blind man, or like a magnet — even so (the difficulty remains).
verses.hindi: If it be said (it works) like the lame man and the blind man, or like a magnet — even so (the difficulty remains).।

verses.translation: Because a relation of principal and subordinate is not possible (among the qualities).
verses.hindi: क्योंकि a relation of principal and subordinate is not possible (among the qualities).।

verses.translation: And even if it is inferred otherwise, the Pradhana lacks the power of intelligence.
verses.hindi: And even if it is inferred otherwise, the Pradhana lacks the power of intelligence.।

verses.translation: And because of contradictions, (the Sankhya doctrine) is inconsistent.
verses.hindi: और contradictions, (the Sankhya doctrine) is inconsistent. होने के कारण।

verses.translation: (The Vaisheshika doctrine:) as the great and the long come from the short and the spherical (atoms) — (this too is refuted).
verses.hindi: (The Vaisheshika doctrine:) as the great and the long come from the short and the spherical (atoms) — (this too is निराकृत).।

verses.translation: In both ways, the (initial) action of the atoms is not possible; therefore there is no (creation from them).
verses.hindi: In both ways, the (initial) action of the atoms is not possible; therefore there is no (सृष्टि from them).।

verses.translation: And because inherence is admitted, and because of similarity, there would be an infinite regress.
verses.hindi: और क्योंकि inherence is admitted, and because of similarity, there would be an infinite regress.।

verses.translation: And because (the atoms) would then be always active (or always inactive).
verses.hindi: और क्योंकि (the atoms) would then be always active (or always inactive).।

verses.translation: And because (the atoms) have colour and so on, the opposite (of their eternity) follows, as is seen.
verses.hindi: और क्योंकि (the atoms) have colour and so on, the opposite (of their eternity) follows, as देखा जाता है.।

verses.translation: And because of faults in both cases.
verses.hindi: और faults in both cases. होने के कारण।

verses.translation: And because (the doctrine) is not accepted (by the wise), it is to be utterly disregarded.
verses.hindi: और क्योंकि (the doctrine) is not accepted (by the wise), it is to be utterly disregarded.।

verses.translation: Even if the aggregate is held to have two causes (atoms and their combinations), the aggregate cannot be formed.
verses.hindi: परमाणु-कारणवाद भी असंगत है, क्योंकि प्रवृत्ति का कोई हेतु सिद्ध नहीं होता।

verses.translation: If it be said (that the aggregate arises) through the mutual dependence of (ignorance and the rest) — no, because these are only causes of origin.
verses.hindi: If it be said (that the aggregate arises) through the mutual dependence of (अविद्या/अज्ञान and the rest) — no, because these are only causes of origin.।

verses.translation: And because, when the later arises, the former has ceased.
verses.hindi: And because, when the later arises, the former has ceased.।

verses.translation: If (the cause) is non-existent (at the time of the effect), the proposition is contradicted; otherwise there would be simultaneity.
verses.hindi: If (the cause) is non-existent (at the time of the effect), the proposition is contradicted; otherwise there would be simultaneity.।

verses.translation: Neither conscious nor unconscious destruction is possible, because of the non-interruption (of the series).
verses.hindi: Neither conscious nor unconscious destruction is possible, because of the non-interruption (of the series).।

verses.translation: And because of faults in both cases.
verses.hindi: और faults in both cases. होने के कारण।

verses.translation: And in the case of space also (it cannot be called mere non-existence), because of no difference.
verses.hindi: And in the case of space also (it cannot be called mere non-existence), because of no भेद.।

verses.translation: And because of memory.
verses.hindi: और memory. होने के कारण।

verses.translation: (Existence) does not come from non-existence, because that is not seen.
verses.hindi: (Existence) does not come from non-existence, because that नहीं देखा जाता.।

verses.translation: And thus (origin from non-existence) would hold even for the indifferent (the inactive).
verses.hindi: And thus (origin from non-existence) would hold even for the indifferent (the inactive).।

verses.translation: There is no non-existence (of external things), because they are perceived.
verses.hindi: There is no non-existence (of external things), because they are perceived.।

verses.translation: And because of the difference in nature, (waking perception is) not like dreams and the like.
verses.hindi: और the भेद in nature, (waking perception is) not like dreams and the like. होने के कारण।

verses.translation: (The idealist says) there is no (external) existence, for want of perception — (this is answered).
verses.hindi: (The idealist says) there is no (external) existence, for want of perception — (this is answered).।

verses.translation: And because of momentariness (there is no memory and no continuity).
verses.hindi: और momentariness (there is no memory and no continuity). होने के कारण।

verses.translation: And because (the doctrine) is untenable in every way.
verses.hindi: और क्योंकि (the doctrine) is untenable in every way.।

verses.translation: (The Jain view is) not (tenable), because contradictory attributes cannot be in one thing.
verses.hindi: (The Jain view is) not (tenable), because contradictory attributes cannot be in one thing.।

verses.translation: And thus the Self would be of imperfect nature (not whole).
verses.hindi: And thus परमात्मा (आत्मतत्त्व) would be of imperfect nature (not whole).।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ न च पर्यायादप्यविरोधः विकारादिभ्यः ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM na cha paryAyAdapyavirodhaH vikArAdibhyaH OM
verses.translation: Nor is there non-contradiction by turns, because of change and so on.
verses.hindi: Nor is there अविरोध by turns, because of change and so on.।

verses.translation: And because the final size of the soul is permanent, and both (the initial and final) are permanent, there is no distinction.
verses.hindi: और क्योंकि the final size of जीवात्मा is permanent, and both (the initial and final) are permanent, there is no distinction.।

verses.translation: (The Pashupata view of God as the instrumental cause only is untenable,) because of inconsistency in the Lord.
verses.hindi: (The Pashupata view of God as the instrumental cause only is untenable,) because of inconsistency in ईश्वर.।

verses.translation: And because of the impossibility of a relation.
verses.hindi: और the impossibility of a relation. होने के कारण।

verses.translation: And because of the impossibility of guiding (the world).
verses.hindi: और the impossibility of guiding (the world). होने के कारण।

verses.translation: If it be said (he directs) like an instrument — no, because (he would then experience) enjoyment and the like.
verses.hindi: If it be said (he directs) like an instrument — no, because (he would then experience) enjoyment and the like.।

verses.translation: (He would then be) finite, or not omniscient.
verses.hindi: (He would then be) finite, or not omniscient.।

verses.translation: Because of the impossibility of origin (of the soul from Sankarshana).
verses.hindi: the impossibility of origin (of जीवात्मा from Sankarshana). होने के कारण।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ न च कर्तुः करणम् ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM na cha kartuH karaNam OM
verses.translation: And the instrument does not originate from the agent.
verses.hindi: And the instrument does not originate from the agent.।

verses.translation: Or if (the four forms) are endowed with knowledge and the like, the objection is not removed.
verses.hindi: Or if (the four forms) are endowed with तत्त्वज्ञान and the like, the objection is not removed.।

verses.translation: And because of contradictions.
verses.hindi: और contradictions. होने के कारण।

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीमत्कृष्णद्वैपायनकृतब्रह्मसूत्रेषु द्वितीयाध्यायस्य द्वितीयः पादः समाप्तः ॐ न वियदश्रुतेः ॐ
verses.transliteration: iti shrImatkR^iShNadvaipAyanakR^itabrahmasUtreShu dvitIyAdhyAyasya dvitIyaH pAdaH samAptaH OM na viyadashruteH OM
verses.translation: Space is not produced, because there is no scriptural statement of it.
verses.hindi: आकाश की भी ब्रह्म से उत्पत्ति होती है, क्योंकि श्रुति में ऐसा कहा गया है।

verses.translation: But there is (such a statement).
verses.hindi: But there is (such a statement).।

verses.translation: (The statement about space's origin) cannot be figurative, because that is impossible.
verses.hindi: (श्रुति का वचन about space's origin) cannot be figurative, because that is impossible.।

verses.translation: And because of the text.
verses.hindi: और the text. होने के कारण।

verses.translation: And the (word "born") may apply to one thing in two senses, as with the word "Brahman."
verses.hindi: And the (word "born") may apply to one thing in two senses, as with the word "परब्रह्म."।

verses.translation: (Otherwise) the proposition (that by knowing one all is known) would fail; the texts show the non-difference (of effects from Brahman).
verses.hindi: (Otherwise) the proposition (that by knowing one all is known) would fail; the texts show the अभेद (अनन्यत्व) (of effects from परब्रह्म).।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ यावद्विकारं तु विभागो लोकवत् ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM yAvadvikAraM tu vibhAgo lokavat OM
verses.translation: But the division (of things) extends as far as modifications, as in the world.
verses.hindi: But the division (of things) extends as far as modifications, as in the world.।

verses.translation: By this, air (Matarishvan) is explained.
verses.hindi: By this, air (Matarishvan) is explained.।

verses.translation: But the origin of the Existent (Brahman) is impossible, because it is unreasonable.
verses.hindi: तेज से जल की उत्पत्ति होती है, क्योंकि ऐसा शास्त्र-वचन है।

verses.translation: Fire (arises) from that (air), for so the text says.
verses.hindi: पृथ्वी की उत्पत्ति जल से होती है।

verses.translation: Water (arises from fire).
verses.hindi: Water (arises from fire).।

verses.translation: Earth (arises from water), because of the context, the colour (mentioned) and other texts.
verses.hindi: Earth (arises from water), because of the प्रकरण (प्रसंग), the colour (mentioned) and other texts.।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ तदभिध्यानादेव तु तल्लिङ्गात् सः ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM tadabhidhyAnAdeva tu talli~NgAt saH OM
verses.translation: (The creation proceeds) from that (Brahman) alone, by his reflection, because of the indication.
verses.hindi: (The सृष्टि proceeds) from that (परब्रह्म) alone, by his reflection, because of the लिंग (संकेत).।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ विपर्ययेण तु क्रमोऽत उपपद्यते च ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM viparyayeNa tu kramo.ata upapadyate cha OM
verses.translation: The order of dissolution is the reverse of that of creation; this is also reasonable.
verses.hindi: The order of प्रलय is the reverse of that of सृष्टि; this is also reasonable.।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ अन्तरा विज्ञानमनसी क्रमेण तल्लिङ्गादिति चेन्नाविशेषात् ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM antarA vij~nAnamanasI krameNa talli~NgAditi chennAvisheShAt OM
verses.translation: If it be said that intellect and mind come in between (the elements) in order, because of the indication — no, because of no specification.
verses.hindi: यदि कहें कि बुद्धि and मन come in between (the महाभूत (तत्त्व)) in order, because of the लिंग (संकेत), तो ऐसा नहीं; क्योंकि of no specification.।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ चराचरव्यपाश्रयस्तु स्यात् तद्व्यपदेशो भाक्तः तद्भावभावित्वात् ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM charAcharavyapAshrayastu syAt tadvyapadesho bhAktaH tadbhAvabhAvitvAt OM
verses.translation: The expressions of birth and death (concerning the soul) refer to bodies, moving and unmoving; they are figurative, because they hold only while the body exists.
verses.hindi: The expressions of birth and death (concerning जीवात्मा) refer to bodies, moving and unmoving; they are figurative, because they hold only while the body exists.।

verses.translation: The soul is not produced, because there is no such statement, and because the texts declare its eternity.
verses.hindi: जीवात्मा की उत्पत्ति नहीं होती, क्योंकि श्रुति में इसका नित्यत्व कहा गया है।

verses.translation: For this very reason the soul is a knower.
verses.hindi: और जीवात्मा ज्ञानानन्द स्वरूप (चेतन) है।

verses.translation: And because of reasoning.
verses.hindi: और reasoning. होने के कारण।

verses.translation: (The soul is atomic, says the objector,) because of its departure, going and coming.
verses.hindi: (जीवात्मा is atomic, says the objector,) because of its departure, going and coming.।

verses.translation: And the latter two (going and coming) are by its own self.
verses.hindi: And the latter two (going and coming) are by its अपने आत्मस्वरूप.।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नाणुरतत् श्रुतेरिति चेन्न इतराधिकारात् ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM nANuratat shruteriti chenna itarAdhikArAt OM
verses.translation: If it be said that it is not atomic because of texts to the contrary — no, because those refer to the other (the Supreme Self).
verses.hindi: यदि कहें कि it is not atomic because of texts to the contrary, तो ऐसा नहीं; क्योंकि those refer to the other (परमेश्वर Self).।

verses.translation: And by direct statement and by measurement.
verses.hindi: And by direct statement and by measurement.।

verses.translation: There is no contradiction, as with sandal paste.
verses.hindi: कोई विरोध नहीं है, as with sandal paste.।

verses.translation: If it be said that (the soul pervades the body) because of its being found in a particular place — no, because of the admitted (location) in the heart.
verses.hindi: यदि कहें कि (जीवात्मा pervades the body) because of its being found in a particular place, तो ऐसा नहीं; क्योंकि of the admitted (location) in the heart.।

verses.translation: Or (it pervades) by its quality (consciousness), like light.
verses.hindi: Or (it pervades) by its quality (चैतन्य), like light.।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ व्यतिरेको गन्धवत् तथा च दर्शयति ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM vyatireko gandhavat tathA cha darshayati OM
verses.translation: The quality extends beyond (its substance), like fragrance; and so scripture shows.
verses.hindi: The quality extends beyond (its substance), like fragrance; and so श्रुति (वेद) shows.।

verses.translation: Because of the separate mention (of the knower and the knowledge).
verses.hindi: गुणात्मक चैतन्य से वह आकाश के समान सर्वत्र व्याप्त है।

verses.translation: But it is called atomic because the qualities of the intellect predominate in it, like the Supreme (in the "Prajna" text).
verses.hindi: But it is called atomic because the qualities of the बुद्धि predominate in it, like परमेश्वर (in the "Prajna" text).।

verses.translation: And there is no fault, since the connection (with the intellect) lasts as long as the soul (is in worldly existence), as scripture shows.
verses.hindi: And कोई दोष नहीं आता, since संबंध (with the बुद्धि) lasts as long as जीवात्मा (is in worldly existence), as श्रुति (वेद) shows.।

verses.translation: It is like maleness and the like: existing (as latent), it becomes manifest at the proper time.
verses.hindi: It is like maleness and the like: existing (as latent), it becomes manifest at the proper time.।

verses.translation: Otherwise there would be either constant perception or constant non-perception, or a restriction to one of the two.
verses.hindi: Otherwise there would be either constant perception or constant non-perception, or a restriction to one of the two.।

verses.translation: The soul is an agent, because scripture has meaning (its injunctions are addressed to an agent).
verses.hindi: जीवात्मा कर्ता है, क्योंकि शास्त्रों में विधि-निषेध उपपन्न होते हैं।

verses.translation: Because of the teaching of its roaming.
verses.hindi: the teaching of its roaming. होने के कारण।

verses.translation: Because of its taking up (the organs).
verses.hindi: its taking up (the इन्द्रियाँ). होने के कारण।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ व्यपदेशाच्च क्रियायां न चेन्निर्देशविपर्ययः ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM vyapadeshAchcha kriyAyAM na chennirdeshaviparyayaH OM
verses.translation: And because of the declaration about action; otherwise the statement would be reversed.
verses.hindi: और the declaration about action; otherwise श्रुति का वचन would be reversed. होने के कारण।

verses.translation: As in the case of perception, there is no fixed rule (of agency).
verses.hindi: As in the case of perception, there is no fixed rule (of agency).।

verses.translation: Because of the reversal of powers (if the intellect were the agent).
verses.hindi: the reversal of powers (if the बुद्धि were the agent). होने के कारण।

verses.translation: And because of the impossibility of absorption (samadhi).
verses.hindi: और the impossibility of absorption (samadhi). होने के कारण।

verses.translation: And as the carpenter (is agent) in both ways (working with tools and resting).
verses.hindi: And as the carpenter (is agent) in both ways (working with tools and resting).।

verses.translation: But (the soul's agency is) from the Supreme, because the text says so.
verses.hindi: किंतु जीवात्मा का कर्तृत्व परमात्मा के अधीन है, क्योंकि श्रुति ऐसा ही कहती है।

verses.translation: But (the Lord acts) with regard to the effort made by the soul, so that injunctions and prohibitions are not meaningless.
verses.hindi: But (ईश्वर acts) with regard to the effort made by जीवात्मा, so that injunctions and prohibitions are not meaningless.।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ अंशो नानाव्यपदेशादन्यथा चापि दाशकितवादित्वमधीयत एके ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM aMsho nAnAvyapadeshAdanyathA chApi dAshakitavAditvamadhIyata eke OM
verses.translation: The soul is a part of the Lord, because of the various declarations (of difference and non-difference); and because some read (Brahman) as "slaves, rogues" and so on.
verses.hindi: जीवात्मा परमात्मा का अंश (प्रतिबिम्ब) है, क्योंकि नाना प्रकार के व्यपदेश हैं।

verses.translation: Because of the mantra.
verses.hindi: the mantra. होने के कारण।

verses.translation: It is also stated in the Smriti.
verses.hindi: It is also stated in स्मृति (गीता आदि).।

verses.sanskrit: पाठभेद अपि च स्मर्यते ॐ प्रकाशादिवन्नैवं परः ॐ
verses.transliteration: pAThabheda api cha smaryate OM prakAshAdivannaivaM paraH OM
verses.translation: The Supreme is not affected thus (by the soul's sorrow), like light and the like.
verses.hindi: परमेश्वर is not affected thus (by जीवात्मा's sorrow), like light and the like.।

verses.translation: And the Smriti says so.
verses.hindi: And स्मृति (गीता आदि) says so.।

verses.translation: Injunction and prohibition apply because of the connection with a body, as in the case of fire and the like.
verses.hindi: विधि and निषेध apply because of संबंध with a body, as in the case of fire and the like.।

verses.translation: And because (the soul) is not all-pervading, there is no confusion (of the results of actions).
verses.hindi: और क्योंकि (जीवात्मा) is not all-pervading, there is no confusion (of the results of actions).।

verses.translation: (The individual soul is) only a reflection (of the Supreme).
verses.hindi: (जीवात्मा is) only a reflection (of परमेश्वर).।

verses.translation: Because of the non-regulation of unseen merit (on the other view).
verses.hindi: the non-regulation of unseen merit (on the other view). होने के कारण।

verses.translation: And so also with intention and the like.
verses.hindi: And so also with intention and the like.।

verses.translation: If it be said that (the regulation is) by place — no, because (all souls) are included (in each).
verses.hindi: यदि कहें कि (the regulation is) by place, तो ऐसा नहीं; क्योंकि (all souls) are included (in each).।

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीमत्कृष्णद्वैपायनकृतब्रह्मसूत्रेषु द्वितीयाध्यायस्य तृतीयः पादः समाप्तः ॐ तथा प्राणाः ॐ
verses.transliteration: iti shrImatkR^iShNadvaipAyanakR^itabrahmasUtreShu dvitIyAdhyAyasya tR^itIyaH pAdaH samAptaH OM tathA prANAH OM
verses.translation: Likewise, the vital breaths (organs) are produced.
verses.hindi: Likewise, the vital breaths (इन्द्रियाँ) are produced.।

verses.translation: (Their origin) cannot be figurative, because that is impossible.
verses.hindi: (Their origin) cannot be figurative, because that is impossible.।

verses.translation: And because the proposition is not contradicted.
verses.hindi: और क्योंकि the proposition is not contradicted.।

verses.sanskrit: पाठभेद sUtra absent ॐ तत्प्राक्श्रुतेश्च ॐ
verses.translation: And because scripture speaks (of the organs) before that (their origin is mentioned).
verses.hindi: और क्योंकि श्रुति (वेद) speaks (of the इन्द्रियाँ) before that (their origin is mentioned).।

verses.translation: Because speech (as an organ) is preceded by (depends on) that.
verses.hindi: क्योंकि speech (as an इन्द्रिय) is preceded by (depends on) that.।

verses.translation: The organs are seven, because of their going (with the soul) and because of specification.
verses.hindi: The इन्द्रियाँ are seven, because of their going (with जीवात्मा) and because of specification.।

verses.translation: But hands and the like are (additional), since they exist; so it is not thus (only seven).
verses.hindi: But hands and the like are (additional), since they exist; so it is not thus (only seven).।

verses.translation: And they are minute.
verses.hindi: And they are minute.।

verses.translation: And the chief (breath) too.
verses.hindi: And the chief (breath) too.।

verses.translation: It is neither air nor a function of it, because of the separate mention.
verses.hindi: It is neither air nor a function of it, because of the separate mention.।

verses.translation: But it is like the eye and the like (subordinate to the soul), because of being taught along with them and so on.
verses.hindi: But it is like the eye and the like (subordinate to जीवात्मा), because of being taught along with them and so on.।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ अकरणत्वाच्च न दोषस्तथा हि दर्शयति ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM akaraNatvAchcha na doShastathA hi darshayati OM
verses.translation: And since it is not an instrument (of knowledge), there is no fault; so scripture shows.
verses.hindi: And since it is not an instrument (of तत्त्वज्ञान), कोई दोष नहीं आता; so श्रुति (वेद) shows.।

verses.translation: It is described as having five functions, like the mind.
verses.hindi: It is described as having five functions, like the मन.।

verses.translation: And it is minute.
verses.hindi: And it is minute.।

verses.translation: But (the organs are) governed by fire and other deities, because scripture teaches it.
verses.hindi: But (the इन्द्रियाँ are) governed by fire and other deities, because श्रुति (वेद) teaches it.।

verses.translation: (They are connected) with the one who has life (the soul), because of the text.
verses.hindi: (They are connected) with the one who has life (जीवात्मा), because of the text.।

verses.translation: And because of the permanence of that (connection).
verses.hindi: और the permanence of that (connection). होने के कारण।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ त इन्द्रियाणि तद्व्यपदेशादन्यत्र श्रेष्ठात् ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM ta indriyANi tadvyapadeshAdanyatra shreShThAt OM
verses.translation: These are the senses, so called except the chief (breath), because of the designation.
verses.hindi: These are the senses, so called except the chief (breath), because of the designation.।

verses.translation: Because scripture speaks of the difference.
verses.hindi: क्योंकि श्रुति (वेद) speaks of the भेद.।

verses.translation: And because of the difference in nature.
verses.hindi: और the भेद in nature. होने के कारण।

verses.translation: But the making of names and forms is by him who makes (the elements) threefold, because of the teaching.
verses.hindi: But the making of names and forms is by him who makes (the महाभूत (तत्त्व)) threefold, because of the teaching.।

verses.translation: Flesh and the like come from earth, according to the text; and (so for the other two elements) also.
verses.hindi: Flesh and the like come from earth, according to the text; and (so for the other two महाभूत (तत्त्व)) also.।

verses.translation: But because of the preponderance (of a particular element), the special designation of each; the designation.
verses.hindi: But because of the preponderance (of a particular element), the special designation of each; the designation.।

verses.sanskrit: अथ तृतीयोऽध्यायः॥ ॐ तदन्तरप्रतिपत्तौ रंहति सम्परिष्वक्तः प्रश्ननिरूपणाभ्याम् ॐ
verses.transliteration: atha tR^itIyo.adhyAyaH|| OM tadantarapratipattau raMhati sampariShvaktaH prashnanirUpaNAbhyAm OM
verses.translation: In passing to another body, the soul goes enveloped by (subtle elements), as is clear from the question and the answer.
verses.hindi: दूसरी देह में जाते समय जीवात्मा सूक्ष्म भूतों से वेष्टित होकर जाता है, जैसा कि प्रश्न और उत्तर से स्पष्ट है।

verses.translation: (Water is named in the question) because the (body-forming) elements are threefold in nature, but water preponderates.
verses.hindi: (Water is named in the question) because the (body-forming) महाभूत (तत्त्व) are threefold in nature, but water preponderates.।

verses.translation: And because of the going of the vital breath (with the soul).
verses.hindi: और the going of the प्राण (with जीवात्मा). होने के कारण।

verses.translation: If it be said that the going of speech and the rest to fire and so on is stated (so that the soul does not carry the elements) — no, because that is figurative.
verses.hindi: यदि कहें कि the going of speech and the rest to fire and so on is stated (so that जीवात्मा does not carry the महाभूत (तत्त्व)), तो ऐसा नहीं; क्योंकि that is figurative.।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ प्रथमेऽश्रवणादिति चेन्न ता एव ह्युपपत्तेः ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM prathame.ashravaNAditi chenna tA eva hyupapatteH OM
verses.translation: If it be said that water is not mentioned in the first oblation — no, because "water" there is faith, which is appropriate.
verses.hindi: यदि कहें कि water is not mentioned in the first oblation, तो ऐसा नहीं; क्योंकि "water" there is faith, which is appropriate.।

verses.translation: If it be said that (the soul's going with water) is not stated — no, because it is understood of those who perform sacrifices and the like.
verses.hindi: यदि कहें कि (जीवात्मा's going with water) is not stated, तो ऐसा नहीं; क्योंकि it is understood of those who perform sacrifices and the like.।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ भाक्तं वाऽनात्मवित्त्वात् तथा हि दर्शयति ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM bhAktaM vA.anAtmavittvAt tathA hi darshayati OM
verses.translation: Or (the statement that they are food for the gods) is figurative, because they do not know the Self; so scripture shows.
verses.hindi: Or (श्रुति का वचन that they are food for the gods) is figurative, because they do not know परमात्मा (आत्मतत्त्व); so श्रुति (वेद) shows.।

verses.translation: When their works are exhausted, souls return with a remainder of karma, as Sruti and Smriti show.
verses.hindi: पुण्य क्षीण होने पर जीव अपने अवशिष्ट (संस्कार रूप) कर्मों के साथ पृथ्वी पर लौटता है।

verses.sanskrit: पाठभेद 3.1.8 and 9 combined ॐ यथेतमनेवं च ॐ
verses.transliteration: pAThabheda ## 3.1.8 and 9 combined## OM yathetamanevaM cha OM
verses.translation: (They return) by the path by which they went, and also otherwise.
verses.hindi: (They return) by the path by which they went, and also otherwise.।

verses.translation: If it be said that (birth is) by conduct — no; conduct is only indicative, says Karshnajini.
verses.hindi: If it be said that (birth is) by conduct — no; conduct is only indicative, says Karshnajini.।

verses.translation: If it be said that (works) would then be useless — no, because conduct depends on them.
verses.hindi: यदि कहें कि (works) would then be useless, तो ऐसा नहीं; क्योंकि conduct depends on them.।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ सुकृतदुष्कृते एवेति तु बादरिः ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM sukR^itaduShkR^ite eveti tu bAdariH OM
verses.translation: Badari holds that (the remainder) is only good and evil works.
verses.hindi: Badari का मत है कि (the remainder) is only good and evil works.।

verses.translation: And it is also stated (that) those who do evil and the like (go to the moon).
verses.hindi: And it is also stated (that) those who do evil and the like (go to the moon).।

verses.translation: But the others, having experienced (suffering) in the realm of Yama, ascend and descend, since their going is so described.
verses.hindi: But the others, having experienced (suffering) in the realm of Yama, ascend and descend, since their going is so described.।

verses.translation: And the Smriti says so.
verses.hindi: And स्मृति (गीता आदि) says so.।

verses.translation: There are also seven (hells).
verses.hindi: There are also seven (hells).।

verses.translation: Even there, there is no contradiction, since (Yama's servants) preside there.
verses.hindi: Even there, कोई विरोध नहीं है, since (Yama's servants) preside there.।

verses.translation: But (the two paths) are for those of knowledge and works, because they are the subject.
verses.hindi: But (the two paths) are for those of तत्त्वज्ञान and works, because they are the subject.।

verses.translation: Not so with the third place, for it is described thus.
verses.hindi: ऐसा नहीं है with the third place, for it is described thus.।

verses.translation: It is also stated in the Smriti, in the world.
verses.hindi: It is also stated in स्मृति (गीता आदि), in the world.।

verses.translation: And because of what is seen.
verses.hindi: और what देखा जाता है. होने के कारण।

verses.translation: The third (place) is included in the word (for creatures born of sweat and the like).
verses.hindi: The third (place) is included in the word (for creatures born of sweat and the like).।

verses.translation: And because of the Smriti.
verses.hindi: और स्मृति (गीता आदि). होने के कारण।

verses.translation: (The soul attains) likeness in nature to (space, wind and so on), because that is appropriate.
verses.hindi: (जीवात्मा attains) likeness in nature to (space, wind and so on), because that is appropriate.।

verses.translation: Not after a very long time (does it descend), because of the specification.
verses.hindi: Not after a very long time (does it descend), because of the specification.।

verses.translation: (It enters) plants presided over by other souls, as in the earlier stages, because of the statement.
verses.hindi: (It enters) plants presided over by other souls, as in the earlier stages, because of श्रुति का वचन.।

verses.translation: If it be said that (the sacrifice) is impure (because it involves killing) — no, because of the scriptural word.
verses.hindi: यदि कहें कि (the sacrifice) is impure (because it involves killing), तो ऐसा नहीं; क्योंकि of the scriptural word.।

verses.translation: Then (comes) union with the one who sheds semen.
verses.hindi: Then (comes) union with the one who sheds semen.।

verses.translation: From the womb, a body.
verses.hindi: From the womb, a body.।

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीमत्कृष्णद्वैपायनकृतब्रह्मसूत्रेषु तृतीयाध्यायस्य प्रथमः पादः समाप्तः ॐ सन्ध्ये सृष्टिराह हि ॐ
verses.transliteration: iti shrImatkR^iShNadvaipAyanakR^itabrahmasUtreShu tR^itIyAdhyAyasya prathamaH pAdaH samAptaH OM sandhye sR^iShTirAha hi OM
verses.translation: In the dream state there is creation, for scripture says so.
verses.hindi: संध्यावस्था (स्वप्न) में सृष्टि होती है, क्योंकि श्रुति ऐसा कहती है।

verses.translation: Some recensions speak of the Self as the creator of sons and other desired objects.
verses.hindi: Some recensions speak of परमात्मा (आत्मतत्त्व) as the creator of sons and other desired objects.।

verses.translation: But it is mere illusion, because its nature is not fully manifest (as in waking).
verses.hindi: किंतु स्वप्न-सृष्टि केवल माया (आभास) है, क्योंकि उसमें सत्य वस्तु के सम्पूर्ण लक्षण प्रकट नहीं होते।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ सूचकश्च हि श्रुतेः आचक्षते च तद्विदः ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM sUchakashcha hi shruteH AchakShate cha tadvidaH OM
verses.translation: And it is an indicator (of future events), according to scripture; and those who know dream-lore say so.
verses.hindi: And it is an indicator (of future events), according to श्रुति (वेद); and those who know dream-lore say so.।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ पराभिध्यानात्तु तिरोहितं ततो ह्यस्य बन्धविपर्ययौ ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM parAbhidhyAnAttu tirohitaM tato hyasya bandhaviparyayau OM
verses.translation: But that (the soul's lordship) is hidden by the will of the Supreme; hence its bondage and the reverse.
verses.hindi: But that (जीवात्मा's lordship) is hidden by the will of परमेश्वर; hence its bondage and the reverse.।

verses.translation: (The concealment is) also owing to the connection with the body.
verses.hindi: (The concealment is) also owing to संबंध with the body.।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ तदभावो नाडीषु तच्छ्रुतेः आत्मनि च ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM tadabhAvo nADIShu tachChruteH Atmani cha OM
verses.translation: The absence of dreams (in deep sleep) is in the channels and in the Self, according to scripture.
verses.hindi: सुषुप्ति नाड़ियों और हृदय के भीतर आत्मा में होती है, क्योंकि श्रुति ऐसा दर्शाती है।

verses.translation: Hence the awakening is from that (Self).
verses.hindi: Hence the awakening is from that (Self).।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ स एव तु कर्मानुस्मृतिशब्दविधिभ्यः ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM sa eva tu karmAnusmR^itishabdavidhibhyaH OM
verses.translation: The same (soul awakens), because of the memory of deeds, the text and the injunction.
verses.hindi: सुषुप्ति से वही जीव पुनः जागता है, क्योंकि कर्म, स्मृति और शास्त्र का नियम है।

verses.translation: In the swoon there is half-attainment (of deep sleep), by elimination.
verses.hindi: In the swoon there is half-attainment (of सुषुप्ति), by elimination.।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ न स्थानतोऽपि परस्योभयलिङ्गं सर्वत्र हि ॐ
verses.transliteration: OM na sthAnato.api parasyobhayali~NgaM sarvatra hi OM
verses.translation: Not even by reason of place can the Supreme have twofold characteristics, for everywhere (scripture describes him as without qualities).
verses.hindi: उपाधि-भेद से भी परब्रह्म में उभय-लिंगता (भेद) नहीं आती, क्योंकि सब जगह वह एकरस ही है।
